# Tomorrow Night Blue

Tomorrow Night Blue applies the Tomorrow Night Blue palette from VS Code to Obsidian, matching editor background, sidebar, tabs, status and title bars, selections and syntax accents into one dark-blue interface. The recorded description calls the theme compact and says it is customized through top-level CSS variables.

![Tomorrow Night Blue screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/packetsherpa/obsidian-tomorrow-night-blue/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Tomorrow Night Blue"
    author: "Damien DeVille"
    repo:   "packetsherpa/obsidian-tomorrow-night-blue"
    slug:   "tomorrow-night-blue"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/tomorrow-night-blue"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/packetsherpa/obsidian-tomorrow-night-blue"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/packetsherpa/obsidian-tomorrow-night-blue/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply VS Code's Tomorrow Night Blue color palette to Obsidian, matching editor background, sidebar, tabs, status/title bars, selections, and syntax accents for a cohesive dark-blue UI. Customize the compact theme via top-level CSS variables."
}
```
